candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record centers on CNS involvement (encephalopathy, chorea, mesodiencephalic MRI hyperintensities, CSF pleocytosis) alongside the mucocutaneous features (oral and genital ulcers). The benchmark specifically requires 'Neuro-Behçet Disease,' emphasizing the neurological manifestation as the primary diagnostic object. C001 names Behçet's Disease with mucocutaneous lesions, which is a parent/component entity but omits the critical neuro qualifier that distinguishes this presentation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies Behçet's Disease with mucocutaneous focus but does not specify the neurological (neuro-Behçet) component, which is the defining feature of the benchmark diagnosis
